text_block_list.text:
Okay, I bought all the stationery I
needed. It's
time to go to the training—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Whoa... the "Meow Meow Adorbs Lottery?!" They brought it back!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean... I'm probably just going to win

third-prize. That's just how the universe
works
around me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Wait... the plushie for the third place is
sooo cute!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's time for the legendary "Bronze
Collector" to
shine!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat?! Why now?! ...Let's do one
more!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: First and then second-prize... Why am I not getting third when I actually want it...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Nature, what comes after first and
second?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Just one more... I just have to rush to
training
once I get this third-prize...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Fourth!? ...Come on, fourth time's a
charm!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Desperate for the prize, Найс Нэйчер
skips her
training for the day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
